text:
Nina Foster: opened a small PR to consolidate the Rate Limits + Metering sections and update all SDK snippets to v2. Also added a short "migration checklist" for Dedicated customers. https://github.com/redwoodinference/docs/pull/903 :sparkles:
Rajiv Gupta: nice. can we add one clear sentence about which tier is debited when reserved+burst are used? customers keep asking for a concrete rule.
Nina Foster: plan: one-line rule + a 3-step numeric example (reserved uses first N tokens, burst covers up to cap, remainder falls back to pay-as-you-go). will add under "How tiers are consumed".
Casey Lin: FYI some examples still reference header `X-Metering`. v2 wants `X-RW-Metering-Context`. also prefer `client.withQuota({tier: '...'})` in the fluent example.
Nina Foster: doing a grep replace now. will swap the header and update fluent calls.
infra-bot: lint-check: found 1 instance of deprecated header in examples/usage.md line 58.
Casey Lin: small nit for dashboard panels: the sample PNG shows metric `usage.requests_per_tier` but the query snippet uses `usage.requests_tier_total`. please make them consistent.
Nina Foster: good catch 9;ll regenerate the panel and update the snippet.
docs-bot: PR 903 updated by nina - header replacement + migration checklist added. snippet-check failed (missing mock).
Rajiv Gupta: I can add a tiny offline test that instantiates a mocked v2 client and asserts the header and `.withQuota()` call. No network.
Casey Lin: please also add a one-line parenthetical about embeddings billing (billed per vector unit, not token). saves support tickets.
Nina Foster: added embeddings note and linked embeddings billing doc. pushed small wording tweak to migration checklist for Dedicated: "Agents <= v3.1 still emit X-Metering; upgrade to agent v3.2+ to use X-RW-Metering-Context."
Rajiv Gupta: pushed fixture -> branch. snippet-check passing locally.
docs-bot: snippet-check: pass after rajiv's fixture. deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-903--docs.redwood.ai/usage/rate-limits-metering
Casey Lin: preview looks good. one request: use single backticks for inline flags and fenced blocks for full code examples to match our linter rules.
Nina Foster: standardized formatting, re-ran linter. merging after Netlify completes. I'll ping #support and #eng-runtime about the header rename and metric-name consolidation so dashboards/alerts don't break. :tada:
